text: Sunrise Interiors - Business Information This is a fictional sample business created for testing a WhatsApp sales bot. 1. About Us Sunrise Interiors is a home and office interior design company based in Mohali, Punjab. We have been in business since 2015 and have completed more than 450 projects across Mohali, Chandigarh, Panchkula and Zirakpur. Our team has 12 designers, 3 project managers and 40 trained carpenters and installers. We handle everything from design to final installation. 2. Process and Timeline Step 1 - Free site visit and measurement within 2 working days of booking (in Mohali, Chandigarh, Panchkula and Zirakpur). Outside these areas a travel charge of Rs. 1,500 applies. Step 2 - Design and quotation in 5 to 7 working days. 3D designs are shared on WhatsApp or email. Step 3 - Booking by paying 10% of the quotation value. This amount is adjusted in the final bill. Step 4 - Execution. Modular kitchen takes 25 to 30 days. A wardrobe takes 15 to 20 days. A full 2 BHK takes 60 to 75 days. A full 3 BHK takes 75 to 90 days. Timelines start after material selection and the advance payment. Step 5 - Handover and cleaning. A final inspection with the customer is done before handover. 6. Payment Terms Stage Payment At booking 10% On design and material approval 40% On delivery of materials to site 40% On completion and handover 10% We accept bank transfer, UPI and cheque. Cash payments are accepted only up to Rs. 20,000. EMI is available through partner banks on orders above Rs. 2,00,000 (subject to bank approval). 7. Warranty and After-Sales We give a 5-year warranty on workmanship and hardware. Plywood and laminate warranty comes from the manufacturer as listed above. Warranty does not cover damage from water leakage from outside, misuse, or changes made by other contractors. Service requests are attended within 3 working days. The first free service visit is within 30 days of handover. 8. Cancellation and Refund Policy Before the site visit: full refund of the booking amount. After the design is shared: the booking amount is non-refundable because design work has started. After materials are ordered: customer pays the cost of the materials already ordered. Refunds, where applicable, are processed within 7 working days. 9. Festival offers may change, so please confirm with our team. 10. Frequently Asked Questions Do you provide interior design for rented homes? Yes, but we recommend portable furniture and wardrobes only. Can I see your past work? Yes. Photos are on our Instagram page, and we can arrange visits to completed homes with the owner's permission. Do you do civil work such as tiling or painting? We offer painting and false ceiling. We do not do major civil work like wall breaking or plumbing. Can I change the design after booking? Yes, small changes are free before material ordering. Big changes may affect price and timeline. Do you work with an architect's drawings? Yes, we can work from your architect's drawings. Do you give discounts? Only the offers listed in this document. Special discounts need owner approval.
